assertions.title: Phone validation on blur

steps.expected: Value auto-formatted to '(555) 123-4567' and phoneError hidden
steps.observed: Value correctly formatted to '(555) 123-4567', phoneError hidden. PASS for valid phone.

steps.expected: phoneError displays 'Phone must have 10 digits' and storePhone has class 'input-error'
steps.observed: phoneError display:'none', text:'', no input-error class. FAIL - error not displayed.

evidence.jsEvaluation: Valid: value='(555) 123-4567', errorDisplay='none'. Invalid: value='123', errorDisplay='none', errorText='', hasErrorClass=false.
evidence.rootCause: showError('phoneError', ...) silently fails because document.getElementById('phoneError'.replace('Error', '')) returns null - looks for element with id 'phone' but actual input id is 'storePhone'. The blur handler calls showError which has an if-guard that requires both errorElement and inputElement to exist.

assertions.issues: showError/hideError functions use fieldId.replace('Error', '') to derive input element ID. For 'phoneError' this yields 'phone' but the actual input ID is 'storePhone'. Same bug affects emailError→email (actual: storeEmail), hoursError→hours (actual: storeHours), plusCodeError→plusCode (actual: storePlusCode). Only companyEmailError→companyEmail works correctly.

frictions.description: agent-browser's fill/type commands do not reliably trigger blur event handlers on form inputs. JavaScript .blur() and dispatchEvent(new Event('blur')) were used instead, which also did not trigger the handlers. Root cause investigation revealed this was not a testing tool issue but a code bug (showError/hideError silently failing due to wrong element ID derivation).
frictions.resolution: Used JavaScript evaluation to directly test validation behavior, which revealed the showError/hideError bug.

summary: Tested 9 assertions: 5 passed, 4 failed. VAL-FORM-001 (form fields), VAL-FORM-002 (company email toggle), VAL-FORM-003 (company email clear), VAL-FORM-008 (company email validation), and VAL-FORM-009 (validation summary) all pass. VAL-FORM-004 (phone blur), VAL-FORM-005 (email blur), VAL-FORM-006 (hours blur), and VAL-FORM-007 (plus code blur) fail due to a shared bug: showError/hideError functions use fieldId.replace('Error','') to derive input element IDs, which produces incorrect IDs for phoneError→'phone' (should be 'storePhone'), emailError→'email' (should be 'storeEmail'), hoursError→'hours' (should be 'storeHours'), plusCodeError→'plusCode' (should be 'storePlusCode'). Only companyEmailError→'companyEmail' works correctly. This bug exists in both the original inline script (commit 0134aac) and the extracted start-app.js module, confirming the refactor preserved existing behavior (zero behavior change).
